history_intro: Founded in 2008, the firm has provided financial statement audits, accounting advisory services, and other review and assurance engagements without interruption for 18 years.

timeline.text: First edition of the “Accountants' Calendar” published
Recommendations for clients; development of the “Nya-Bo” app
Use of artificial intelligence (AI) in audit work

mission: To provide professional support and assistance to businesses, organisations and individuals, and to help stakeholders obtain accurate, reliable information by verifying and attesting the results of economic activity.

principles.title: Reliability
principles.text: We act objectively and deliver truthful, reliable services, free from any constraint that could affect our independence.

principles.title: Integrity
principles.text: We provide reasonable assurance on whether financial statements and accounting policies are accurately prepared and comply with laws and regulations.

principles.title: Trust
principles.text: We deliver audit services to professional standards and work to earn the trust of our clients and of the users of financial statements.

principles.title: Accountability
principles.text: We audit in accordance with laws and standards and take full responsibility for the accuracy of our opinions.

value_chain.title: Reporting entities and organisations
value_chain.text: Prepare their financial statements and engage an independent auditor

value_chain.title: Financial statement audit
value_chain.text: We form an opinion on whether the statements are accurate and prepared in accordance with standards

value_chain.title: Users of financial statements
value_chain.text: Make decisions based on verified, reliable information

differentiators.title: Recommendations for every client
differentiators.text: Since 2022 we have provided all our clients with recommendations on both common and client-specific matters.

differentiators.title: Monthly newsletter
differentiators.text: Every month we email our clients updates on IFRS, accounting and tax matters.

differentiators.title: “Nya-Bo”, a first for Mongolia
differentiators.text: In development since 2022, its web version will launch very soon, and our clients will be able to use it free of charge.

differentiators.title: Accountants' Calendar
differentiators.text: Since 2019 we have printed and delivered, every year, a calendar containing the information accountants need.

audit_focus: Determining whether the financial statements are free from material misstatement and irregularities
Assessing whether the financial statements have been prepared in accordance with applicable laws, accounting standards and the rules issued by the Ministry of Finance
Issuing an opinion on the financial statements and providing recommendations
